name: sf-guardian
description: Salesforce helper for Claude Code: production guard that detects your orgs, coding standards and naming prefix, live code checks (SOQL/DML in loops, unknown fields), org schema and SOQL tools for Claude, live Files sidebar, deploy and test failures with file and line, coverage, audit log, /sfdoctor

prod_orgs.title: Production orgs
prod_orgs.description: Aliases or usernames that are always production, separated by commas. Orgs are also detected from sf org list; this list wins over detection.

safe_orgs.title: Safe orgs (never production)
safe_orgs.description: Aliases or usernames that are never production, separated by commas: Developer Edition and trial orgs, which sf lists like production.

guard_mode.title: Guard mode
guard_mode.description: ask: changes to production or unknown orgs ask first. block: they are refused, and only reads go through.

guard_scripts.title: Guard scripts
guard_scripts.description: Look inside npm scripts, make and shell scripts for sf commands. A script that cannot be read asks while the default org is production or unknown.

guard_mcp.title: Guard Salesforce MCP tools
guard_mcp.description: deploy_metadata, assign_permission_set, delete_org and resume_tool_operation ask first on production or unknown orgs.

backup_before_deploy.title: Back up before production deploys
backup_before_deploy.description: Before a deploy to a production or unknown org runs, retrieve what it will overwrite into .sfdx/sf-guardian/backups, and warn when the org holds changes that are not in git. /sfguard backups lists restore commands.

allow_secret_commands.title: Allow secret commands
allow_secret_commands.description: Let Claude run sf org auth show-access-token, show-sfdx-auth-url and show-user-password, which print secrets into the conversation.

coding_standards.title: Coding standards
coding_standards.description: In Salesforce projects, give Claude the SF Guardian coding standards (simple code, no comments, complete and correct) and flag comments in code.

name_prefix.title: Component name prefix
name_prefix.description: Prefix every NEW Apex class, trigger and LWC must use, for example INV (classes INV_Name, LWC inv_name). Empty: names are not checked.

code_checks.title: Code checks
code_checks.description: Check Apex and LWC as Claude writes it: SOQL or DML in loops, hard-coded ids, missing sharing, System.debug, comments, and SOQL fields that do not exist in the default org.

audit_log.title: Audit log
audit_log.description: Keep a local record of the last 500 guarded commands (cleaned of secrets). See /sfguard. Nothing is sent anywhere.

auto_open_files.title: Open the Files sidebar automatically
auto_open_files.description: Open the live Files sidebar the first time a file changes in a session.

live_typing.title: Live typing in the Files sidebar
live_typing.description: Show a file's text while Claude writes it, before it is saved. Drafts stay in memory only.

files_pane_width.title: Files sidebar width
files_pane_width.description: Width of the Files sidebar in terminal columns.

compact_sf_rows.title: Compact sf command rows
compact_sf_rows.description: Draw sf deploys and Apex test runs as short rows with a summary. Ctrl+O still shows everything.

show_band.title: Org status above the prompt
show_band.description: Show the org badge, untested Apex, changed files and the last deploy above the prompt.

coverage_target.title: Coverage target (%)
coverage_target.description: Coverage at or above this shows green. Below 75% shows red.

code_analyzer.title: Run Code Analyzer
code_analyzer.description: After a turn that changed Apex or LWC, run sf code-analyzer on the changed files. Needs the code-analyzer plugin (and Java for some engines).

editor_command.title: Editor command
editor_command.description: Editor for the o key in the Files sidebar. Runs <command> -g <file>:<line>, or use {file} and {line} placeholders, for example: idea --line {line} {file}

notify.title: Notify when deploys and tests end
notify.description: Send a system notification when a deploy, validation or test run finishes.

remember_files.title: Remember the file list
remember_files.description: Keep the Files sidebar list (paths and counts, never content) across restarts, per folder.
